blocks.text: Minerals inorganic maadde hain jo jaandaron ke liye zaroori tabeei-kimiyai amal barqarar rakhne ko chahiye. Yeh tawanai nahi dete, lekin bohat si sargarmiyon mein in ke ahem kaam hain. Minerals macro (bare) anasir aur micro (trace) anasir mein taqseem hote hain.

items: Macro-minerals mein calcium, phosphorus, sodium aur chloride shamil hain.
Micro-elements mein iron, copper, cobalt, potassium, magnesium, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium, selenium aur sulfur shamil hain (jaisa kitab mein fehrist hai).

blocks.title: Ikaaiyan aur fehristein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke macro-minerals 100 mg/dL se zyada aur micro-minerals kam miqdar mein chahiye; aam had taqreeban 100 mg rozana hai. Potassium, magnesium aur sulfur ko aam taur par macro-minerals gina jata hai, trace elements nahi.

blocks.explanation: Calcium; maslan doodh aur doodh ki ashya (hari sabziyan, sardines, phaliyan, matar aur daalein bhi).

items: Minerals: inorganic, tawanai nahi, zaroori kaam; macro aur trace.
